title: Niko and the Moon
style: a big fluffy grey Maine coon cat with ear tufts
pages: One night, Niko the cat saw a big round moon in the window.
a big fluffy grey Maine coon cat sitting on a windowsill at night looking up at a huge glowing full moon, cozy bedroom
It looks like a giant ball of cheese, thought Niko. I must catch it!
a big fluffy grey cat with wide excited eyes, thought bubble showing a wheel of yellow cheese, moon in night sky
He climbed the sofa. He climbed the bookshelf. He climbed all the way up to the roof.
a big fluffy grey cat climbing on the roof of a little house at night, chimney, stars, huge moon above
Niko jumped as high as he could. But the moon was much too far away.
a big fluffy grey cat leaping high in the air from a rooftop reaching a paw toward the full moon, starry sky
So Niko curled up in the moonlight and purred. The moon could stay in the sky. The end.
a big fluffy grey cat curled up asleep on a rooftop in soft blue moonlight, smiling moon above, peaceful

title: The Pancake That Ran Away
style: a little girl chef with strawberry blonde hair and purple glasses
pages: Chef Marina flipped a pancake so high, it flew right out of the pan!
a little girl with strawberry blonde hair, purple glasses and a white chef hat flipping a pancake very high out of a frying pan in a kitchen, surprised face
You can't eat me, giggled the pancake, and it rolled out the door.
a round golden pancake with a cute smiling face and tiny legs rolling out of a kitchen door, cartoon
It rolled past Daddy. It rolled past Mommy. It rolled past the baby.
a round smiling pancake rolling fast down a hallway past surprised family legs and a laughing baby, motion lines
Then the pancake saw a big puddle of syrup. Ooh, it said. A swimming pool!
a round smiling pancake jumping happily into a big shiny puddle of maple syrup on a plate, splash
Marina tiptoed over with her fork. Yum, she said. The best pancake ever. The end.
a little girl with strawberry blonde hair and purple glasses in a chef hat happily holding a fork next to a plate of pancakes with syrup, cozy kitchen

title: The Dragon Who Was Scared of the Dark
pages: Dot was a little green dragon. She was brave all day long.
a small cute green baby dragon standing proudly on a sunny hill with flowers, blue sky
But at night time, the cave got very, very dark. And Dot was scared.
a small cute green baby dragon hiding under a blanket in a dark cave at night, big worried eyes
What if there is a monster? she whispered.
a small cute green baby dragon peeking nervously at a big spooky shadow on a dark cave wall
Dot took a big breath and went, puff! A tiny flame lit up the cave.
a small cute green baby dragon blowing a small warm orange flame that lights up a cave, glowing light
It was only her own teddy bear! Dot made her own night light, and she slept all night. The end.
a small cute green baby dragon sleeping happily hugging a teddy bear next to a little glowing lantern in a cozy cave

title: Baby Miles and the Giant Bubble
style: a cute bald baby boy in a white onesie
pages: Baby Miles was in the bath when he blew a bubble.
a cute bald baby boy sitting in a bathtub full of foam blowing a soap bubble, rubber duck, bathroom
The bubble grew bigger, and bigger, and bigger!
a cute bald baby boy in a bathtub looking amazed at an enormous shiny soap bubble growing above him
Pop! Miles was inside the bubble, and it floated out the window.
a cute bald baby boy in a white onesie sitting happily inside a giant floating soap bubble drifting out of an open window
He floated over the house. He waved at the birds. He waved at the cat.
a cute bald baby boy inside a giant soap bubble floating high above a little house with autumn trees, waving at birds, blue sky
Then the bubble went pop, and Miles landed right in Mommy's arms. Again! said Miles. The end.
a cute bald baby boy laughing while landing in the arms of a smiling blonde mother, sparkles of a popped bubble around them, garden
